rationale: Records the source analysis behind the registered propagation question, showing that the persistent reading has a concrete path through a stale-configuration leader's own later snapshot, and leaves the question open without a defect judgment.

interpretations.rationale: Source-only account of the two readings, recorded so the registered question is self-contained. On the receiving side, installSnapshot decodes the request's configuration and index, installs them into both latest and committed, sets lastApplied and lastSnapshot to the request's last log index and term, and compacts the log below that index (raft.go:1880-1975); the follower then continues to receive AppendEntries for entries above the snapshot index, and processConfigurationLogEntry updates its tracked configuration for any configuration entry in that range (raft.go:1595-1620). That supports the transient reading whenever the correcting entry lies above the installed snapshot index. The persistent reading has a concrete source path rather than only a hypothetical one: a node whose tracked committed configuration is the stale one (the state this run observes after a replay-enabled restart) writes exactly that configuration into any snapshot it takes afterwards, because takeSnapshot reads the tracked committed configuration and index from the main thread and passes them to SnapshotStore.Create (snapshot.go:155-190). If such a node is the leader and takes a new snapshot, the entry that would correct a joiner - the committed removal that its own log still contains - lies below the new snapshot's index, so a joiner that installs that snapshot receives no configuration entry above the snapshot index and keeps the stale membership. Compaction does not rescue it: trimming retains the trailing logs above the snapshot index, and the corrective entry is below it. What remains unobserved rather than uncertain is the execution: no receipt in this run ships a snapshot to a joiner, so the account makes no defect judgment here and leaves the question open with its discriminator.
counterevidence: The persistent path depends on the stale-configuration node taking a further snapshot after its restart; a node that never snapshots again keeps its original snapshot, whose index lies below the corrective entry, so its joiner would be corrected by the re-sent entries.

This account infers from the writing and reading code; it offers no observation of a joiner's tracked configuration, and the install path's interaction with the joiner's own concurrent snapshotting is not examined.
limitations: Source-only, with no execution; the mechanism is stated as what the code permits, not as an observed propagation.
The trimming rule is taken from the compaction path this run reads for other purposes; its interaction with a concurrent install on the same store is not studied here.
